symptoms: Small brown circular spots on leaves, sometimes water-soaked
Spots may coalesce into dark streaks
General yellowing and severe epinasty of leaves
Green fruits: raised brown lesions, sometimes scab-like, may have halo
favorable_conditions: Leaves remaining wet for long periods
Injuries caused by insects, wind-driven sand, or tools
disease_cycle: Survives on infected plant debris and volunteer plants
Seed-borne transmission (even 1 infected seed in 10,000 can cause full infection)
Spread by wind, rain, workers, and tools
Enters plants through stomates or wounds
cultural_control: Use certified, disease-free seeds and seedlings
Rotate fields and eliminate volunteer plants
chemical_control: Application more effective preventively or at early infection stages
notes: Resistance in cultivars is often race-specific
